faqs.question: What amenities are included in Phoenix X vacation rentals?
faqs.answer: Phoenix X features several luxury amenities, including indoor and outdoor pools, hot tubs, a fitness center, tennis courts, covered parking, and barbecue grills.

faqs.question: What types of units are available for rent at Phoenix 10?
faqs.answer: Phoenix 10 offers spacious 2-, and 3- bedroom units, ranging in size from approximately 1,950 to 2,550 square feet.

faqs.question: What popular attractions are close to Phoenix X?
faqs.answer: At Phoenix X, you’ll enjoy direct access to Orange Beach’s most popular attraction, the sugar-white sand and calm emerald-green waters of the Gulf. From your Phoenix X condo, you can walk to the world-famous Flora-Bama beach bar, Flora-Bama Yacht Club, and more. With marinas nearby, you have easy access to the Gulf and the bay for fishing, water sports, and dolphin tours. faqs.answer: All Phoenix 10 units have private balconies and floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing views of the Gulf.

faqs.question: Is there beach access available at Phoenix X?
faqs.answer: Yes, Phoenix X condos have direct beach access, and beach chair rentals for available for guests.

faqs.question: Is there a grocery store nearby Phoenix 10 where guests can purchase food, supplies and necessities?
faqs.answer: Yes, there are several grocery stores located near Phoenix 10, including Publix, Walmart, and Winn-Dixie. Grocery delivery is offered at participating stores with partnering apps.

faqs.question: Does Phoenix X have accessibility options?
faqs.answer: Phoenix X is equipped with accessibility features to ensure that guests can enjoy their stay. The resort has accessible entrances and public areas, including ramps and elevators. The units were also originally designed with accessibility in mind. Contact us at 1-800-211-7892 to discuss accommodations and options.

faqs.question: Is Phoenix 10 a good choice for family vacations?
faqs.answer: Yes, Phoenix 10 in Orange Beach is great for families. With open layouts in spacious, fully-furnished units that sleep up to 11 guests, Phoenix 10 condos are perfect for families. There are also plenty of family-friendly amenities for children of all ages on the property. Phoenix 10 has indoor and outdoor pools, a kiddie pool, hot tubs, tennis courts, shuffleboard, barbeques, and more.
